decision_conditions: It is hereby certified that on the 10th April 2026, the use described in the 'Description of development' hereto in respect of the land edged in red on Location Plan (Oct 2025), would have been lawful within the meaning of Section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended), for the following reason:
It has been demonstrated, on the balance of probabilities, that the application site has been used as a car park for more than 10 years.

This certificate applies only to the extent of the use/operations described in the 'Description of development' and to the land edged in red on the drawing Location Plan (Oct 2025). Any use/operation which is materially different from that described, or which relates to any other land, may result in a breach of planning control which is liable to enforcement action by the local planning authority.
description: Existing use of the site as a car park with 28 formal parking spaces and overspill parking (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for an Existing Use)
